title: CIA psychiatrist explains why Hall was chosen: 41 men before him came back compromised

tellings.quote: He said the 41 men that went out before me who all came back compromised and some of them burned.

plain: Before him, 41 men had been sent out to deal with tall, white, human-like beings in the Nevada desert, and all of them "came back compromised and some of them burned," Charles Hall says. He tells Michels a CIA psychiatrist he does not name told him this. Hall says he spent three years with these beings in the 1960s at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada, and writes about it in his book Millennial Hospitality; by this account, he was chosen because he could do what the men before him could not.
